description.value:
Cost 1 Bandwidth

Traits Paradise-Touched, Glimpse

Choose a point within 30 feet. For 1 minute, within a 30-foot radius of that point, difficult terrain and greater difficult terrain do not exist for you and your allies — you move through the area at full Speed. Enemies are unaffected and the terrain is unchanged for them. The area is fixed where you chose it and does not move with you.

cinderfall.incomplete: Cost 1 Bandwidth: fixed 30-ft-radius area ignores difficult terrain for you and allies, 1 minute. Hands a new usable capability (bucket 3) on top of the Bandwidth cost; also no clean selector for 'ignore difficult terrain in a fixed area' regardless. No `SpecialResource` rule element exists anywhere in the corpus for Bandwidth -- confirmed corpus-wide (`grep -rl "\"key\": \"SpecialResource\"" site/data/cards/` returns zero hits), and the class card itself (`site/data/cards/classes/classes.paradise-touched.json:49`) ships `system.rules: []`. Same absence class as Cultist Zeal/Ironsight Drift/Fleshmancer Vitae.
